booking_verifications_email_format.name: booking_verifications_email_format
booking_verifications_email_format.value: "booking_verifications"."email" = lower("booking_verifications"."email") AND length("booking_verifications"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND "booking_verifications"."email" LIKE '%_@_%'

bookings_duration_range.name: bookings_duration_range
bookings_duration_range.value: "bookings"."ends_at" - "bookings"."starts_at" BETWEEN interval '5 minutes' AND interval '720 minutes'

member_scope.name: member_scope
member_scope.using: (SELECT current_member_sees_all()) OR id IN (SELECT client_id FROM bookings) OR id IN (SELECT client_id FROM waitlist_entries) OR (SELECT current_client_contact()) IN (email, phone)

clients_email_format.name: clients_email_format
clients_email_format.value: "clients"."email" = lower("clients"."email") AND length("clients"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND "clients"."email" LIKE '%_@_%'

invite_lookup.name: invite_lookup
invite_lookup.using: current_tenant_id() IS NULL AND token_hash = current_invite_token_hash()

member_read.name: member_read
member_read.using: current_tenant_id() IS NULL AND user_id = current_user_id()

member_scope.name: member_scope
member_scope.using: current_user_id() IS NULL OR user_id = current_user_id()
member_scope.withCheck: current_user_id() IS NULL OR user_id = current_user_id()

services_price_to_after_from.name: services_price_to_after_from
services_price_to_after_from.value: "services"."price_to_cents" IS NULL OR ("services"."price_from_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."price_to_cents" > "services"."price_from_cents")

tasks_due_scan_idx.name: tasks_due_scan_idx
tasks_due_scan_idx.where: "tasks"."status" = 'open' AND "tasks"."due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."due_notified_at" IS NULL

member_scope.name: member_scope
member_scope.using: (SELECT current_member_sees_all()) OR assignee_user_id = current_user_id() OR created_by_user_id = current_user_id()
member_scope.withCheck: (SELECT current_member_sees_all()) OR assignee_user_id = current_user_id() OR created_by_user_id = current_user_id()

member_read.name: member_read
member_read.using: current_tenant_id() IS NULL AND id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM memberships WHERE user_id = current_user_id())

public_lookup.name: public_lookup
public_lookup.using: current_tenant_id() IS NULL AND slug = current_public_slug()
